body:
> Note: _reading_ any of these (advanced) settings in a script using `ProjectSettings.get_setting` with the old setting name will obviously fail, but this is such a corner case that I doubt anyone is doing that with these advanced settings (including physics enthusiasts).

While this is mostly true, as I could seemingly only find [one single project](https://github.com/317gw/HYPERLUNATIC/blob/06527085b6df095953856c1f2f5e2ffc298ade37/assets/systems/water_physics/scripts/fluid_mechanics.gd#L85-L87) across all of GitHub that was reading some of these settings from scripts, the bigger issue is that the Rapier extension currently relies on `physics/2d/time_before_sleep` and `physics/3d/time_before_sleep`, as seen [here](https://github.com/appsinacup/godot-rapier-physics/blob/14859d3cd4489236deade9ed379de9301722908e/src/bodies/rapier_collision_object_base.rs#L19-L30), so this PR will break compatibility there.

It would technically be possible to move the Jolt module over to use that setting, and then keep `physics/3d/time_before_sleep` in the `physics/3d` category, but unfortunately the sleep velocity thresholds don't make much sense in the context of Jolt, so you'd end up having the settings split up, which would be pretty weird.

Would it maybe make sense to not actually clear the old values, but just leave them in there, so that at least any existing code reading them wouldn't break?
